The places in your apps that show a paywall: list and view them, choose what each shows, show an end
user or a group a paywall of their own, and see what they showed before.

An app asks for a location by its slug and gets the paywall it shows. What is asked first decides:
an end user's pin, then the first rule that matches them, then what the location shows everyone.
Apps using a test key get the same unless the location is given a test showing, pins or rules of its
own (--env test).

Usage:
  voidhash location <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  location, locations

Commands:
  list       List the places in your apps that show a paywall, with what each shows now.
  view       Show a location: what it shows now, in test, to pinned end users and by rule, and
             before.
  create     Create a place in your apps that shows a paywall.
  edit       Rename a location or change its description.
  show       Show a paywall's live build at a location from now on.
  clear      Stop showing anything at a location, so apps asking for it get no paywall.
  pin        Show one end user a paywall of their own at a location.
  unpin      Remove an end user's pin at a location.
  rule       Show another paywall at a location to the end users a rule matches.
  history    List what a location has shown, most recent first.
  archive    Archive a location your apps no longer ask for.
  bundle     Write the flows your app ships, shown when a location cannot be loaded.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash location <command> --help' for more about a command.
